items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: Dick Sudhalter new book on Hoagy Carmichael.

ctx.x: Dick Sudhalter new book on Hoagy Carmichael. The music illustrations Justin copied for him. So I mean he’s doing — right now he’s copying some symphony stuff for me.
Do you write your scores — are the individual instruments transposed?
